args.title: Robustly trim multiple trailing empty lines in CSV parser
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim trailing empty lines robustly in the CSV parser by replacing the single `lines.pop()` with a `while` loop that pops all trailing empty lines from the `lines` array. This prevents multiple trailing newlines at the end of a CSV file from producing trailing empty string elements that fail shape validation as malformed rows.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Multiple consecutive trailing newlines leave extra empty strings in the parsed lines array because `lines.pop()` only removes one, causing `assertShape` to fail on a malformed row.
